title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: launch a Data Security Investigation from a case
summary: Hold: the permissions guidance wrongly limits usage-dashboard access to members of the dedicated Data Security Investigations Admins group, although other groups inherit the required admin role. It also omits the Exchange admin center role assignment needed for audit cmdlets and overstates the need for dedicated investigation-group membership for Global Administrators.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a pre-scoped investigation launched from an IRM case to review a risky user's content and post-incident data impact.
claims.quote: they can launch a pre-scoped investigation directly from an IRM case, allowing them to view content analysis related to that user and better assess post-incident data impact.

claims.claim: The IRM membership path is Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Roles and groups > Roles groups > Insider Risk Management > Edit > Choose users.

claims.fix: Change controls[2].governs to 'AI capacity set-up for Data Security Investigations'. Its printed path configures AI capacity, not the separately documented storage-billing setup.
